1.text: Ndi nka habaseleti y'i Sharoni,N'umwangange wo mu bibaya. Umukwe:

2.text: Nka karungu mu mahwa,Ni ko umukunzi wanjye ameze mu bakobwa. Umugeni:

3.text: Nk'umutapuwa mu biti byo mu ishyamba,Ni ko umukunzi wanjye ameze mu bahungu.Nicaye mu gicucu cye nezerewe cyane,Amatunda ye yarandyoheye.

4.text: Yanjyanye mu nzu y'ibirori,N'ibendera rye ryari hejuru yanjye,Ari ryo rukundo.

5.text: Nimumpembure n'imbuto z'uruzabibu,Mundamirishe amatapuwa,Kuko urukundo runsābye.

6.text: Ukuboko kwe kw'ibumoso kuranseguye,N'ukuboko kwe kw'iburyo kurampfumbase. Umukwe:

7.text: Mwa bakobwa b'i Yerusalemu mwe,Mbarahirije amasirabo n'impara zo mu gasozi,Ntimukangure umukunzi wanjye ngo abyuke,Kugeza igihe abyishakira. Umugeni:

8.text: Ijwi ry'umukunzi wanjye,Dore araje asimbuka mu mpinga z'imisozi miremire,Asimbagurika ku misozi.

9.text: Umukunzi wanjye ameze nk'isirabo,Cyangwa umucanzogera w'impara.Dore ahagaze inyuma y'inkike yacu,Arebera mu madirishya,Agaragarira hagati y'imbariro.

10.text: Umukunzi wanjye atangira kuvuga arambwira ati“Haguruka mukunzi wanjye mwiza,Ngwino tujyane.

12.text: Uburabyo butangiye kurabya ku isi,Igihe cyo kujwigira kw'inyoni kirageze,Kandi ijwi ry'intungura ryumvikanye mu gihugu cyacu.

13.text: Umutini weze imbuto zawo z'umwimambere,Kandi inzabibu zirarabije,Impumuro yazo nziza iratāmye.”Haguruka mukunzi wanjye mwiza,Ngwino tujyane.

14.text: Numa yanjye we, uri mu mitutu y'urutare,No mu bishumiko byo mu bihanamanga,Reka ndebe mu maso hawe,Numve n'ijwi ryawe,Kuko ijwi ryawe ari ryiza,N'uburanga bwawe bukaba buhebuje.

15.text: Mudufatire ingunzu,Bya byana by'ingunzu byonona inzabibu,Kuko inzabibu zacu zirabije.

16.text: Umukunzi wanjye ni uwanjye ubwanjye nanjye ndi uwe,Aragirira mu myangange.

17.text: Kugeza mu mafu ya nimunsi,Izuba rikendakenda,Garuka mukunzi wanjye,Umere nk'isirabo cyangwa umucanzogera w'impara,Mu mpinga z'imisozi y'i Beteri. Umugeni:
